links.comparator_used: Original unhighlighted discharge notes as LLM input (GPT-4o summarization)
links.outcome: Summary completeness, correctness and structural integrity
links.effect: Completeness 96% for H-summaries, 8% higher than U-summaries; H-summaries had higher completeness in 13 of 15 notes (P=.01). Errors 2 vs 3. Fewer improper headers for H-summaries in 11 notes vs 4 for U-summaries (P=.03). Misplaced information 2 in H-summaries vs 8 in U-summaries.
links.quote: On average, summaries from highlighted notes (H-summaries) achieved 96% completeness, 8% higher than the summaries from unhighlighted notes (U-summaries).

design_hint: Highlighting key concepts in input notes to improve LLM summary accuracy
